::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 6 1868  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS.55388 (1): P.99
:::

Dear Miss Yonge,
Don’t you think that an Index and some chronological tables would be of similar use to the [Cameos](cmy_books/cmybook_73.qmd)? If you agree with [me](people/person_939.qmd) I can get them done. The printer is making a table of contents of which you shall see a proof. 

I enclose a letter about the terrible story(?). But I think the [Little Duke](cmy_books/cmybook_20.qmd) has been close and [*rest of paragraph indecipherable*]

I hope you like the gilt-edged copy of the [Pupils](cmy_books/cmybook_72.qmd).

Yours very faithfully
A. Macmillan

---

**Note:** Although dated earlier than the previous letter from Macmillan, this letter is placed after it in the Macmillan letter book
